en.title: Netflix's December 2026 Slate Drops: Pride & Prejudice, Pitt, and Boxing!
en.summary: Get ready to clear your calendars! Netflix is closing out 2026 with a bang, featuring a star-studded lineup of original films, beloved series returns, and even live sports.
en.body:
Netflix is pulling out all the stops for December 2026, delivering a holiday season packed with prestige television, blockbuster films, and unexpected live spectacles. The streaming giant is set to release a highly anticipated new adaptation of **Jane Austen's** *Pride and Prejudice*, helmed by **Dolly Alderton**. Early buzz highlights **Emma Corrin** stepping into the iconic role of Elizabeth Bennet, with **Jack Lowden** as the brooding Mr. Darcy and the incomparable **Olivia Colman** as Mrs. Bennet. This six-episode series is poised to be a major draw for literary fans and binge-watchers alike, offering a fresh perspective on a timeless romance.

Beyond Austen, December 2026 brings **Brad Pitt** back to the screen as the unforgettable stuntman Cliff Booth in *The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth*. Penned by **Quentin Tarantino**, this film promises the sharp dialogue and stylish violence fans have come to expect from the auteur director. Adding to the cinematic excitement is **Brad Bird**'s animated feature *Ray Gunn*, a project that has been generating significant anticipation for its unique visual style and imaginative storytelling. For those seeking true crime drama, **Melissa McCarthy** and **Clive Owen** star in *The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey*, a production that is sure to spark conversation and debate.

## The Binge-Worthy Breakdown

For the dedicated series fans, December promises a wealth of new seasons and continuations. **Dolly Alderton's** *Pride and Prejudice* is set to be a major event, with its six-episode run designed for immediate immersion. Fans of reality television can look forward to the tenth season of **Selling Sunset**, promising more luxury real estate drama and interpersonal entanglements across its ten episodes. The animated world gets a boost with new installments of **CoComelon** (Season 16) and **The Later Daters** (Season 2). Furthermore, beloved sitcoms like **2 Broke Girls** will have all six seasons available for a complete rewatch, alongside intriguing new dramas such as the Thai series *Empress of Flames*.

## Beyond the Screen: Live Events and Nostalgia

Netflix isn't just about scripted content this December; they're also venturing into live entertainment with significant force. The platform will host **Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua**, a boxing match that is already being billed as the fight of the year. Adding to the sporting spectacle, Netflix will air a Christmas Day NFL doubleheader, a move that signals a major push into live sports broadcasting. For those craving more familiar faces, **Emily in Paris** returns for its sixth season, and **Avatar: The Last Airbender** continues its epic journey with Season 2, ensuring that fan-favorite franchises have new chapters to explore. The month also includes a diverse range of documentaries, such as *Dolphins: My Close Encounter*, and comedy specials like **Gianmarco Soresi's** *God Forbid*.

## What's Next

With a release calendar this packed, December 2026 is shaping up to be a landmark month for Netflix subscribers. Keep an eye on official announcements for specific release dates for the live events and any surprise additions to the schedule.
